core_meaning.primary_meaning: AbdurRashid (عبد الرشيد) is a theophoric compound name meaning “servant of the Rightly-Guided One”, from ʿabd (“servant”) and al-Rashid, a divine name meaning “the Rightly-Guided” or “the Guide to the right path”. It is a common male Muslim name. The name is not Qur'anic as a personal name, though the root ر ش د and the divine attribute are Qur'anic.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The first element is ʿabd (“servant”), used in construct with a divine name in Islamic naming convention. Al-Rashid is transmitted as a divine name, and the root ر ش د means right guidance. The compound is a theophoric name, not a historical title like the X al-Din compounds.
